# configuration file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf:
user www-data;
worker_processes auto;
pid /run/nginx.pid;
error_log /var/log/nginx/error.log;
include /etc/nginx/modules-enabled/*.conf;

events {
	worker_connections 768;
	# multi_accept on;
}

http {

	##
	# Basic Settings
	##

	sendfile on;
	tcp_nopush on;
	types_hash_max_size 2048;
	# server_tokens off;

	# server_names_hash_bucket_size 64;
	# server_name_in_redirect off;

	include /etc/nginx/mime.types;
	default_type application/octet-stream;

	##
	# SSL Settings
	##

	ssl_protocols TLSv1 TLSv1.1 TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3; # Dropping SSLv3, ref: POODLE
	ssl_prefer_server_ciphers on;

	##
	# Logging Settings
	##

	access_log /var/log/nginx/access.log;

	##
	# Gzip Settings
	##

	gzip on;

	# gzip_vary on;
	# gzip_proxied any;
	# gzip_comp_level 6;
	# gzip_buffers 16 8k;
	# gzip_http_version 1.1;
	# gzip_types text/plain text/css application/json application/javascript text/xml application/xml application/xml+rss text/javascript;

	##
	# Virtual Host Configs
	##

	include /etc/nginx/conf.d/*.conf;
	include /etc/nginx//sites-enabled/*;
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/conf.d/solutionmines-zones.conf:
# ============================================================================
# Install to /etc/nginx/conf.d/solutionmines-zones.conf
#
# Everything here is http-context and must exist regardless of which site file
# is enabled. Keeping the zones and the upstream OUT of the site file is what
# lets the HTTP-only and TLS site configs be swapped without a duplicate-zone
# error.
#
# This is the ONLY file of ours in conf.d. The upstream line and the proxy
# snippet live elsewhere (/etc/nginx/solutionmines/, /etc/nginx/snippets/),
# because nginx loads every conf.d/*.conf at http level, where a bare
# `server ...;` or `proxy_pass` is a syntax error.
# ============================================================================

limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=sm_contact:10m rate=10r/m;
limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=sm_general:10m rate=120r/m;

upstream solutionmines_app {
    # Rewritten by deploy.sh on every blue/green switch. Do not edit by hand.
    include /etc/nginx/solutionmines/upstream.conf;
    keepalive 16;
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/solutionmines/upstream.conf:
server 127.0.0.1:3001;

# configuration file /etc/nginx//sites-enabled/solutionmines:
# ============================================================================
# HTTP-only site. Install to /etc/nginx/sites-available/solutionmines.
#
# This is what runs BEFORE a certificate exists, so the deploy can be verified
# on the bare IP while DNS is still pointing elsewhere. `enable-tls.sh`
# replaces it with the TLS config once certbot has issued.
# ============================================================================

server {
    listen 80 default_server;
    listen [::]:80 default_server;
    server_name _;

    # Not indexable before the real domain is live. A staging-shaped origin
    # getting crawled creates duplicate-content damage that takes months to
    # unwind, and robots.txt alone has repeatedly proven insufficient.
    add_header X-Robots-Tag "noindex, nofollow" always;

    location /.well-known/acme-challenge/ {
        root /var/www/certbot;
    }

    client_max_body_size 1m;

    gzip on;
    gzip_vary on;
    gzip_comp_level 6;
    gzip_min_length 1024;
    gzip_types text/plain text/css application/javascript application/json
               image/svg+xml application/manifest+json;

    location /_next/static/ {
        include /etc/nginx/snippets/solutionmines-proxy.conf;
        add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=31536000, immutable";
        access_log off;
    }

    location /api/ {
        limit_req zone=sm_general burst=20 nodelay;
        include /etc/nginx/snippets/solutionmines-proxy.conf;
        add_header Cache-Control "no-store" always;
    }

    location / {
        limit_req zone=sm_general burst=40 nodelay;
        include /etc/nginx/snippets/solutionmines-proxy.conf;
    }
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/snippets/solutionmines-proxy.conf:
# Shared proxy settings, included from inside each `location`.
# Install to /etc/nginx/snippets/solutionmines-proxy.conf.
#
# NOT conf.d: the stock nginx.conf loads conf.d/*.conf at http level, where
# proxy_pass is not allowed, and `nginx -t` fails for the whole box.
proxy_pass http://solutionmines_app;
proxy_http_version 1.1;
proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";
proxy_set_header Host $host;
proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
# Without this, Next generates http:// URLs in metadata and redirects, so
# canonical tags and the sitemap quietly point at the wrong scheme.
proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Host $host;
proxy_read_timeout 30s;
proxy_connect_timeout 5s;
# Let nginx fail over to the other colour if one is mid-restart.
proxy_next_upstream error timeout http_502 http_503 http_504;
